with base as (
  select s.month_end, s.account_id, a.is_internal,
         max(case when s.status in ('active','past_due') then 1 else 0 end) as is_cust
  from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id)
  group by 1,2,3),
m as (select * from base where month_end='2025-03-31' and is_cust=1 and not is_internal),
a as (select * from base where month_end='2025-04-30' and is_cust=1)
select count(*) as start_logos,
       sum(case when a.account_id is null then 1 else 0 end) as churned,
       sum(case when a.account_id is null then 1 else 0 end)*1.0/count(*) as logo_churn_rate
from m left join a using(account_id)

    seats * unit_price_minor * (1 - discount_pct) / power(10, minor_unit_exponent) * usd_per_unit
      / case when billing_interval = 'year' then 12 else 1 end as mrr_usd
  from marts.fct_subscription_months s
  join marts.dim_accounts a using (account_id)
  where month_end = '2025-06-30'

)

WITH s AS (
  SELECT s.account_id, a.is_internal, a.is_deleted, s.month_end,
         bool_or(s.status IN ('active','past_due')) AS paying
  FROM marts.fct_subscription_months s JOIN marts.dim_accounts a USING(account_id)
  WHERE s.month_end IN (DATE '2025-04-30', DATE '2025-05-31')
  GROUP BY ALL
),
acct AS (
  SELECT account_id, is_internal, is_deleted,
         bool_or(paying AND month_end='2025-04-30') AS apr,
         bool_or(paying AND month_end='2025-05-31') AS may
  FROM s GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT count(*) FROM acct WHERE apr AND NOT may AND NOT is_internal AND NOT is_deleted;
